title: NS Client has no temp targets
symptom: Temp targets set in AAPS 3.0.0.1 are not showing up in NSClient app 3.0.0.1. Sending remote temp targets from NSClient to AndroidAPS also stopped working.
fix: Started to use Dexcom G6 (vs G5); did another update to AAPS 3.0.0.1 (I had returned to 2.8.2 while using G5) and then noticed that temp targets were going through.
